basis: 50 fictional project requests frozen before baseline; reference leads, not full feasibility. Broader coverage and evidence quality measured separately. Agent-authored, not independently human-validated. Holdout outputs are sealed until implementation is frozen. No case is included in model prompts.

cases.review: Place discovery does not establish dietary inventory.
